frozen.warmup_position: observed turn_id / max(1, trajectory_turns - 1); shuffle occupied thirds each round

interpretation.grpo_k6: more main-rollout control, not automatically token/time matched; K also changes the GRPO group estimator
interpretation.linear_ucb_b2_l0: same probe-count pipeline without credit, not guaranteed equal actual token cost or identical random stream
interpretation.cost: report generated tokens, logged step time, checkpoint time and launcher wall time separately; none is automatically billed GPU hours
interpretation.endpoint: primary endpoint is step 200; steps 50/100/150 are prespecified diagnostics, never select the best held-out checkpoint
interpretation.training_exposure: 800 prompt instances per run, 1.5625 dataset-pass equivalents; no convergence guarantee
interpretation.history: v1 completed 50-step results and v2 50-step preparation are preserved separately; never pool endpoints
